{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: 🐧 Linux

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        compiler: [g++, clang++]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: 🐧 Linux (${{ matrix.compiler }})
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@main
      - name: Prepare Environment
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install mesa-common-dev xorg-dev
      - name: Configure
        run: |
          cd example
          cmake -B build -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler }} -DIMPLOT3D_STRICT_WARNINGS=ON
      - name: Build
        run: |
          cd example
          cmake --build build
", "rationale": "The build job has no explicit time bound, so a stuck or runaway build can consume VM time up to the default 360 minutes. Representative successful-duration history exists (five recent runs, all successful, each about 1-2 minutes), satisfying the precondition for deriving a timeout from history (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). Adding timeout-minutes: 30 bounds runaway consumption while giving ample headroom over the observed ~2 minute duration, including cold dependency installation. It preserves the matrix, build, and test coverage exactly, changes no permissions, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]}
